SSS81.name: 空时鲛
SSS81.form: a long tapered snout on a streamlined head, narrow angular jaws lined with even needle teeth, five slim parallel gill slits, a low even keel along the flank, matte crystalline hide with crisp facet cuts
SSS81.fins: a tall triangular dorsal fin, a matched pair of swept pectoral fins, a crescent tail fin with a long upper lobe
SSS81.markings: a single row of evenly spaced luminous pores along the flank
SSS81.colour: 深靛底、冷银棱面，尾缘一线冷光

SSS82.name: 千年魟
SSS82.form: a wide diamond disc with evenly stepped edges, a pair of short cephalic lobes at the snout, layered ridge rings across the back, a long thin whip-like tail
SSS82.fins: broad wing-like pectoral fins fused to the disc, a small dorsal fin near the tail base
SSS82.markings: concentric growth rings radiating across the disc, a row of sparse luminous pores along the wing margin
SSS82.colour: 琥珀褐底、年轮状浅层，边缘冷金线

SSS83.name: 时纱水母
SSS83.form: a domed translucent bell with a thin layered rim, four evenly spaced tentacle clusters around the margin, a central trailing veil of long ribbon tentacles
SSS83.markings: a ring of luminous pores along the bell margin, faint concentric seams across the dome
SSS83.colour: 薄纱白、冷浆色伞心，触手尾端淡蓝

SSS84.name: 虚年章鱼
SSS84.form: a long slender mantle tapering to a faceted rear tip, triangular side fins running along the mantle, eight arms of even length set in a ring, two long trailing feeding tentacles
SSS84.fins: triangular side fins with straight bevelled edges along the mantle
SSS84.markings: a single row of luminous pores down the rear mantle, faint ringed seams on each arm
SSS84.colour: 虚空灰蓝底、棱面反光，腕足环纹冷白

SSS85.name: 逆旅鮟鱇
SSS85.form: a very deep rounded body, a very large head, a wide upward-gaping mouth, small eyes set high, a curved lure rod rising over the snout
SSS85.fins: small rounded pectoral fins, a short dorsal fin, a rounded tail fin
SSS85.markings: a luminous tip on the snout lure, rows of sensory pores along the head and jaw
SSS85.colour: 暗褐底、苔绿斑驳，诱饵一点冷青

SSS86.name: 纪元巨鲨
SSS86.form: a heavy streamlined head, a long tapered snout, wide jaws lined with even triangular teeth, five long gill slits, a low keel along the flank, smooth matte hide
SSS86.fins: a tall triangular dorsal fin, long swept pectoral fins, a crescent tail fin with a long upper lobe
SSS86.markings: faint layered ridge lines banding the flanks
SSS86.colour: 深蓝黑底、纪元铜锈边，通体冷光

SSS87.name: 时光巨龙
SSS87.form: a serpentine body with evenly spaced dorsal spines along the ridge, a pair of swept-back head horns, two long barbels trailing from the jaw, glass-like scales in overlapping rows
SSS87.fins: a continuous low dorsal crest of thin rays, a pair of narrow pectoral fins, a long tapering tail fin
SSS87.markings: a double row of luminous nodes down the spine
SSS87.colour: 墨蓝底、时光琥珀纹，脊线冷金

SSS88.name: 千年巨鲸
SSS88.form: a vast rounded head with a gentle forehead, deep parallel throat pleats running back along the belly, small set eyes, a heavy body tapering to the tail stock
SSS88.fins: long slim pectoral flippers, a small set-back dorsal fin, a wide notched horizontal fluke
SSS88.markings: ringed growth lines across the head shield, a row of pores along the jaw line
SSS88.colour: 暗青灰底、千年年轮浅圈，腹面冷银

SSS89.name: 逆流皇带
SSS89.form: a small pointed head, a short blunt snout, a small forward dorsal fin, a pair of long trailing pelvic-fin rays, crest rays evenly spaced and tapering toward the tail
SSS89.fins: a full-length dorsal crest of thin rays, long trailing pelvic-fin rays, a small tail fin
SSS89.markings: a single row of luminous pores along the flank
SSS89.colour: 银粉底、逆流冷光脊，全长星屑线

SSS90.name: 时之褶皱·空鲸
SSS90.form: an immense smooth body wrapped in deep layered folds along the throat and belly, a heavy rounded head, extra overlapping pleat layers, a slim dorsal fin set far back
SSS90.fins: long slim pectoral flippers, a small set-back dorsal fin, a wide notched horizontal fluke
SSS90.markings: layered fold lines along the belly, a row of pores along the jaw line
SSS90.colour: 墨青底、层叠褶皱暗金边，深渊冷白
